prompt: How many versions of the .NET platform have been released that have a support lifetime of more than 12 months?
answer:
**12 versions** of the modern .NET platform have had support lifetimes longer than 12 months.

This includes .NET Core 1.0 through 2.2, 2.1, 3.1, and .NET 5 through 10—excluding **.NET Core 3.0**, which was supported for only about six months.
